# HSDS v3.2.3 objects

24 objects. The four core objects come first, then the rest in the order of the official tabular data package.

| Object | Tabular file | Fields (scalar + nested) | Required fields | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| [`organization`](organization.md) (core) | `organizations.csv` | 13 + 9 | `id`, `name`, `description` | The details about each organization delivering services. Each service should be linked to the organization responsible for its delivery. One organization may deliver many services. |
| [`service`](service.md) (core) | `services.csv` | 23 + 15 | `id`, `name`, `status` | The details of the services provided by organizations to a range of different groups. |
| [`location`](location.md) (core) | `locations.csv` | 12 + 8 | `id`, `location_type` | The locations where organizations operate. Locations may be virtual, and one organization may have many locations. |
| [`service_at_location`](service_at_location.md) (core) | `service_at_location.csv` | 4 + 7 | `id` | A link between a service and a specific location. |
| [`program`](program.md) | `programs.csv` | 5 + 2 | `id`, `name`, `description` | The details of collections of related services. |
| [`attribute`](attribute.md) | `attributes.csv` | 7 + 2 | `id` | A link between a service and one or more classifications that describe the nature of the service provided. |
| [`phone`](phone.md) | `phones.csv` | 10 + 3 | `id`, `number` | The details of the telephone numbers used to contact organizations, services, and locations. |
| [`contact`](contact.md) | `contacts.csv` | 9 + 3 | `id` | The details of the named contacts for services and organizations. |
| [`address`](address.md) | `addresses.csv` | 11 + 2 | `id`, `address_1`, `city`, `state_province`, `postal_code`, `country`, `address_type` | The addresses of locations where organizations operate. |
| [`schedule`](schedule.md) | `schedules.csv` | 23 + 2 | `id` | The details of when a service or location is open. Entries are RFC 5545 RRULES. |
| [`funding`](funding.md) | `funding.csv` | 4 + 2 | `id` | The sources of funding for a service or organization. |
| [`service_area`](service_area.md) | `service_areas.csv` | 8 + 2 | `id` | The details of the geographic area for which a service is available. |
| [`required_document`](required_document.md) | `required_documents.csv` | 4 + 2 | `id` | The details of any documents that are required in order to access or use services. |
| [`language`](language.md) | `languages.csv` | 7 + 2 | `id` | The languages that are spoken at locations or services. This does not include languages which can only be used with interpretation. |
| [`accessibility`](accessibility.md) | `accessibility.csv` | 5 + 2 | `id` | The details of the arrangements for access to locations for people who have disabilities. |
| [`taxonomy_term`](taxonomy_term.md) | `taxonomy_terms.csv` | 9 + 2 | `id`, `name`, `description` | Each service can be categorized according to one or more taxonomy terms. The taxonomy_term object contains a list of taxonomy terms, their names, and, for hierarchical taxonomies, their structure. |
| [`metadata`](metadata.md) | `metadata.csv` | 9 + 0 | `id`, `last_action_date`, `last_action_type`, `field_name`, `previous_value`, `replacement_value`, `updated_by` | A record of the changes that have been made to the data in order to maintain provenance information. |
| [`meta_table_description`](meta_table_description.md) | `meta_table_descriptions.csv` | 4 + 2 | `id` | Metadata about individual tables. |
| [`cost_option`](cost_option.md) | `cost_options.csv` | 8 + 2 | `id` | The costs of a service at certain points in time. This is an LGA Extension. This object provides a structured version of the text information contained in the 'fees' field of the 'service' object. |
| [`organization_identifier`](organization_identifier.md) | `organization_identifiers.csv` | 5 + 2 | `id`, `identifier_type`, `identifier` | The details of the third party identifiers for organizations, such as: company registration number, charity number, tax registration number. |
| [`taxonomy`](taxonomy.md) | `taxonomies.csv` | 5 + 1 | `id`, `name`, `description` | The taxonomies from which taxonomy terms are taken. |
| [`service_capacity`](service_capacity.md) | `service_capacity.csv` | 7 + 3 | `id`, `unit`, `available`, `updated` | The details of service capacities for services. |
| [`unit`](unit.md) | `units.csv` | 5 + 2 | `id`, `name` | The details of units which are used to measure service capacity. |
| [`url`](url.md) | `url.csv` | 5 + 2 | `id`, `url` | A URL with a label |
